tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:28
tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, conformance of colour and compliance with the visual specification.

details.specification: White or almost white, crystalline powder or colorless crystals

tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:29
tests.procedure: Stepwise solubility (BP descriptive terms) at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C: 100 mg in a stoppered tube + 0.1 mL solvent, shake vigorously 1 min, hold 15 min at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C, repeat shake/hold once if not dissolved. Dissolved = very soluble. Not dissolved: add 0.9 mL (freely soluble if dissolved), then 2 mL (soluble), then 7 mL (sparingly soluble), each step shake 1 min + 15 min hold (repeat once). Then 10 mg powdered substance + 10 mL solvent (slightly soluble), then 1 mg + 10 mL (very slightly soluble), otherwise practically insoluble. Repeat with ethanol (96 per cent).

solvents: water (implied for first pass, not named)
details.specification: Freely soluble in water, slightly soluble in ethanol (96 per cent)

tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:30
tests.procedure: Reaction of sulfate (BP Appendix VI, Sulfate (a)): To 0.4 mL of iodinated potassium iodide solution add 8 mL distilled water and 1 mL of solution S diluted 1 to 10 in distilled water; the solution is colorless. Use 5 mL of the solution, add 1 mL dilute hydrochloric acid and 1 mL barium chloride solution R1.

details.reference: BP Appendix VI Qualitative Reactions and Tests, Sulfate(a)

tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:30
tests.procedure: Reaction of sodium (BP Appendix VI, Sodium (a)): 2 mL solution S + 2 mL of a 150 g/L potassium carbonate solution, heat to boiling, no precipitate is formed; add 4 mL potassium pyroantimonate solution, heat to boiling, cool in iced water.

details.intermediateObservation: no precipitate after carbonate and boiling
details.specification: A dense white precipitate is formed
details.reference: BP Appendix VI Qualitative Reactions and Tests, Sodium(a)

details.reference: BP Appendix IV A Clarity of Solution, Appendix IV B Colour of Solution

tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:34
tests.procedure: Limit test, visual colour comparison. Test solution: 10 mL solution S + 2 mL of 200 g/L citric acid monohydrate solution + 0.1 mL thioglycollic acid, mix, make alkaline with ammonia, dilute to 20 mL with water. Standard solution: 10 mL iron standard solution (1 ppm Fe) treated identically. After 5 min any pink colour in the test solution is not more intense than in the standard.

details.standard: 10 mL iron standard solution (1 ppm Fe)
details.reference: BP Appendix VII Limit Tests, Iron

tests.source: Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:35; Sodium Meta bisulfit__Sodium Metabisulfit - SM without arsenic.txt:26
tests.procedure: Residual (back) iodometric titration. Dissolve 0.200 g in 50.0 mL of 0.05 M iodine, add 5 mL dilute hydrochloric acid, titrate the excess iodine with 0.1 M sodium thiosulfate using 1 mL starch solution added towards the end as indicator. Calculation as printed: %Assay = (E.p x Eq.wt x F) / Wt x 100; E.p = end point (mL), Eq.wt = 4.753 mg, F = factor of titrant, Wt = sample weight (g).

details.indicator: starch solution 1 mL near end point
details.equivalence: each mL of 0.05 M iodine is equivalent to 4.753 mg of Sodium Metabisulfite
details.titrantPreparation: 0.1 M sodium thiosulfate VS: dissolve 25 g sodium thiosulfate and 0.2 g sodium carbonate in carbon dioxide-free water, dilute to 1000.0 mL
details.titrantStandardization: To 10.0 mL of 0.033 M potassium bromate add 40 mL water, 10 mL potassium iodide solution and 5 mL hydrochloric acid R1; titrate with thiosulfate, 1 mL starch solution added towards the end. 1 mL of 0.1 M sodium thiosulfate is equivalent to 2.783 mg of [text cut off] or 0.5 mL of 0.033 M potassium bromate
details.iodinePreparation: 0.05 M iodine VS: dissolve 12.7 g iodine and 20 g potassium iodide in water, dilute to 1000.0 mL
details.iodineStandardization: To 10.0 mL of the iodine solution add 1 mL dilute acetic acid and 40 mL water; titrate with 0.1 M sodium thiosulfate, starch indicator
details.starchSolution: 1.0 g soluble starch triturated with 5 mL water, poured with stirring into 100 mL boiling water containing 10 mg mercuric iodide
details.potassiumBromate033M: 5.5670 g potassium bromate in water, dilute to 1000.0 mL
details.analystEntersFinalValue: Decision 2026-11-04: was Titration in the transcription; now Measurement, the analyst enters the final value.
